scope: Forward MP4 WebVTT inline timestamp clock under the existing ctim sample anchor
method: Current-source inspection and primary-format reference; no runtime execution
priorMapping: item.start + delta/1000*track.timescale + delta%1000*track.timescale/1000 - mediaOrigin (integer ticks before scaling)
newMapping: sample-origin tick clock plus deltaMs*65536/(rateFixed*1000), combined before final millisecond rounding
limits: No runtime, parser, browser, player or reference IDM execution.
ctim anchor semantics use the existing UDM decoder contract; no new conformance claim.
